purpose: Petlya mascot design exploration, not approved production assets
prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: professional mascot character development sheet for a personal-training app linking trainers and clients. The attached image is a CONCEPT REFERENCE for the black elastic loop mascot with tiny white eyes, NOT a layout to replicate. Develop a new variant of that mascot. Generate a clean landscape character design sheet on UNIFORM PURE WHITE #FFFFFF background all the way to all four edges. No dark background, no vignette, fog, glow, gradients in background, dramatic light or presentation effects. No phone, UI, mockup, promotional text, logos, fitness equipment, hands holding dumbbells, trophies, hearts or decorations. Composition: title top left, one large hero occupying left half, THREE clearly separated smaller poses on right labeled "Привет", "Движение", "Отдых". Bottom small two silhouette tests of the SAME hero, one black on white and one white in a black square. Lots of breathing space. Only those exact Russian words and the specified title; all text dark black and clean. A friendly calm adult-facing companion, curious, quietly humorous, never childish, tired or upset about missed workouts. Character has ONE continuous CLOSED elastic loop body with one prominent open white hole. Avoid ordinary doughnut, infinity sign, rope knot, pretzel, snake, letterform, disconnected ribbon ends, human torso, separate head, face in central hole. Two tiny cream oval eyes sit together ON THE UPPER RIGHT PART OF THE BLACK BAND and remain there consistently through all poses. Silhouette conveys effort and rest through stretching, leaning, squashing; eyes can blink during rest. No teeth, mouth, clothes, nose, realistic human anatomy. Strong graphic design; immediately legible at small scale. Hero, three poses and mini tests MUST depict the same anatomy.
Title exactly "01 · ЛЕНТА".
Variant specification: Body is a WIDE FLAT matte black resistance-band ribbon forming a tall asymmetric closed loop, slightly folded near the base, with a single restrained grey inside edge that reveals the flat ribbon surface. Upper shoulder leans inquisitively, bottom has a stable soft folded contact with ground. Clear wide hollow center. NO arms or legs. Crisp nearly flat vector-style rendering with controlled overlap. Hero pose resembles an elegant flexible irregular teardrop, not the number 8. Three poses: whole loop tilts a friendly greeting; elongates for stretch with tension visible in curvature; compresses low and wide for rest. This is the closest refined continuation of original reference and must read as an elastic training band brought to life.

Title exactly "02 · МЯГКИЙ".
Variant specification: Body is a PLUMP ROUND-CROSS-SECTION matte charcoal silicone tube, one seamless CLOSED loop shaped as a soft asymmetric rounded triangle with wide empty middle, chunky cushioning proportions, a charming little top tilt. NO arms or legs. Sculptural tactile soft rubber, very gentle diffuse ambient shading ON THE CHARACTER ONLY, pure white background, no gloss/plastic shine, no photorealistic scene, no clay fingerprints. Thick but not doughnut-shaped. Three poses retain tube thickness and eye placement: curious sideways tilt, stretched tall elastic pose, low comfortable flattened horizontal loop with closed eyes. Adult designer-toy refinement and elastic energy, warm and approachable.

Title exactly "03 · КОНТУР".
Variant specification: Make the most distilled GRAPHIC version: a single unbroken CLOSED black outline band, flat solid ink, no shading whatsoever. Band relatively slender compared with big empty center, about 1/8 of overall width, with slight controlled width variation to carry two white eyes on a wider upper-right shoulder. Base is asymmetrically flattened and top softly bent, as if the whole loop is leaning forward curiously. NO arms or legs. Signature silhouette based on a lopsided rounded quadrilateral, never a regular circle, infinity mark or standard teardrop. Ultra-economical Swiss graphic design meets charming character animation. Three poses distort the same closed contour: leaning greeting, long diagonal reaching stretch, wide squashed relaxed loop. No brushes, sketch texture or ornamental linework.

Title exactly "04 · ЖЕСТ".
Variant specification: Explore a more ACTING-focused character: a thick flat matte black CLOSED flexible loop with a wide rounded triangular hole, one side of the loop bending outward into an integrated soft elbow-like gesture. Two tiny short rounded feet emerge from bottom band, same black material; NO separate arms, hands, fingers or head. The loop itself acts as shoulders and an arm through its outer contour. Stable compact silhouette, wide enough to feel grounded, top subtly cocked with curiosity. Crisp flat editorial cartoon with no shading and no grain. Three consistent poses: the side of the loop lifts into a friendly waving bend while remaining closed; the whole loop leans into an enthusiastic balanced stretch on its two small feet; sitting low with its two feet stretched forward and sleepy closed eyes. Charming quiet personality, not an aggressive gym coach, never add a head or detach the loop. Clearly different from a simple abstract logo while still reading as a loop.
